reviews_1s:
There are many serious problems:
1) The summary is that there is no way for me to hold a hot mug of coffee without getting burned.
2) The handle permits only two fingers (index and middle) vs. three for all my other mugs.
3) My other mugs stay level if I hold three fingers in the handle and my thumb on the top. However, yours rotates and would spill the mug when it is full.
4) If I try to steady the mug with my middle finger, it gets burned on the mug .
5) If instead I try to use my thumb, the mug rotates unless my thumb touches the mug, which burns my thumb.
6) Finally, if I use my ring finger under the handle, I cannot support the mug until that finger touches the mug and burns my finger.Poured coffee in 2 cups this morning when we used them for the first time.
